name: Tyler Gecawich
bio: Hi! My name is Tyler Gecawich, and I am a senior at East Greenwich High School and your 2026-2027 Rhode Island FBLA Social Chair! Through my experiences in photography, digital content, and leadership, I have developed a passion for creativity and connecting with others. I look forward to creating engaging content, celebrating our members, building new websites and helping showcase all that Rhode Island FBLA has to offer!
